_note: Each fund type uses one long-running fund as a stand-in for its past performance. These are data sources only and are never shown to users as recommendations. We use Regular plans because they go back further (Direct plans only began in 2013), so the ranges include bad decades like 2008. Regular plans have slightly higher fees, which makes the numbers a little conservative. Among matching funds, the script picks the one with the longest history that is still updating. To force a fund, set schemeCode.
